M7 5000W Electric Dirt Bike – Built for Extreme Off-Road Adventures

Experience powerful off-road performance with the M7 Electric Dirt Bike, built for riders who demand speed, power, and control. Featuring a 5000W peak motor, 60V 27Ah removable lithium battery, and professional suspension system, the M7 delivers impressive acceleration, long-lasting power, and confidence on challenging terrain.

With a top speed of 43 MPH, up to 31 miles of range, and a rugged all-terrain design, the M7 is ready for trails, mountains, forests, rocky roads, and outdoor adventures.

Unleash 5000W Powerful Performance

The M7 is equipped with a high-performance 5000W electric motor that provides strong torque and instant power delivery.

Whether climbing steep trails or riding through rough terrain, the powerful motor delivers smooth acceleration and reliable performance when you need it most.

60V 27Ah Long-Range Lithium Battery

Go further with a high-capacity removable lithium battery.

60V 27Ah battery capacity

Up to 31 miles riding range

Stable power output

Easy removal and charging

Designed for extended outdoor adventures

Built for Any Terrain

The M7 is engineered for serious off-road riding.

From forest trails to rocky mountain paths, the combination of high ground clearance, aggressive tires, and professional suspension helps you maintain control in demanding environments.

Professional Suspension System

Ride smoother with advanced front and rear suspension.

Upside-down front fork

Long-travel suspension

Adjustable rear shock

Improved impact absorption

Enhanced stability on rough terrain

Smart LCD Display & LED Headlight

Stay informed and ride confidently with integrated technology.

Speed

Battery level

Riding mode

Mileage information

The bright LED headlight improves visibility for safer night riding.

Designed for Adult Riders

The M7 features an ergonomic design with a comfortable riding position.

Ready for Your Next Adventure

From weekend trail rides to outdoor exploration, the M7 Electric Dirt Bike delivers the power, durability, and control needed to conquer new terrain.

Take your off-road experience to the next level with the M7 5000W Electric Dirt Bike.
